knowledge_package.summary: Master demonstration of drawing a traditional 3x3 dot Sikku Kolam with continuous curved loops and bilateral symmetry.

claims.statement: Place a 3x3 grid of dots with uniform 2-inch spacing on a dark flat surface.

evidence_refs.cue_excerpt: Expert marks 9 equidistant dots with rice flour

claims.statement: Draw a continuous curved line that wraps outside the outer dots without touching dot centers.

evidence_refs.cue_excerpt: Continuous line weaves around outer dots keeping 1cm clearance

claims.statement: Maintain identical arc radius across both left and right quadrants for bilateral symmetry.

evidence_refs.cue_excerpt: Symmetrical loop arcs mirrored across horizontal and vertical axes

rubric.title: Sikku Kolam 3x3 Evaluation Rubric
rubric.description: Criterion-level evaluation for 3x3 dot grid Kolam geometry, loop continuity, and bilateral symmetry.

criteria.name: Dot Grid Setup
criteria.description: Learner positions 9 dots in a 3x3 rectangular grid with equidistant spacing.
criteria.observable_indicator: 3 rows of 3 visible dots with variance in dot-to-dot distance < 15%

criteria.name: Continuous Loop Enclosure
criteria.description: Drawn curves loop around all outer dots without cutting through or intersecting dot centers.
criteria.observable_indicator: All outer loops maintain clear clearance around dot centers without intersecting line segments

criteria.name: Bilateral Symmetry
criteria.description: Curves exhibit reflective balance along both vertical and horizontal centerlines.
criteria.observable_indicator: Quadrant arc curvature matches within 20% area tolerance

practice_task.title: Practice 3x3 Continuous Sikku Kolam
practice_task.instructions: Place 9 equidistant dots in a 3x3 grid on the board. Then, in a single continuous flowing stroke, weave loops around the outer dots, ensuring no dot is intersected and maintaining quadrant symmetry.

constraints.description: Complete the full pattern within 60 seconds
Chalk on slate or rice flour on dark mat

evidence.cue_excerpt: Learner sets up dots and attempts continuous loop on slate

criterion_results.observed_finding: Learner placed 9 clear dots in a 3x3 pattern with uniform spacing within 10% variance.
criterion_results.deviation_analysis: Grid matches expert reference layout closely.

evidence_ref.cue_excerpt: Nine dots visible on slate in 3x3 arrangement

criterion_results.observed_finding: At timestamp 00:18, learner line crosses directly through the center of Dot #4 instead of circling around its perimeter.
criterion_results.deviation_analysis: Violates fundamental Sikku Kolam rule where lines must never intersect dot markers.

criterion_results.observed_finding: Right loop quadrant is circular and smooth, but left loop has an abrupt angular bend causing 35% area asymmetry.
criterion_results.deviation_analysis: Lacks the bilateral reflection shown in the master demonstration.

evidence_ref.cue_excerpt: Left quadrant arc noticeably flatter than right arc

feedback.summary: Solid grid layout (20/20 on C01)! To achieve full competency on retry, avoid crossing Dot #4 with your chalk line and balance the symmetry between your left and right loops.

items.what_was_observed: At 00:18, your chalk crossed directly through the center of Dot #4.
items.what_differed: In Sikku Kolam, loops wrap around the outside of dots without touching them. The master demo maintains 1cm clearance.
items.corrective_advice: Guide your hand 1-2 cm wider around Dot #4 to create a smooth outer envelope rather than cutting through it.

expert_evidence_ref.cue_excerpt: Continuous line weaves around outer dots keeping 1cm clearance

items.what_was_observed: Your left quadrant loop was flatter and more angular than the round right loop.
items.what_differed: The master pattern exhibits bilateral mirror symmetry across the central vertical axis.
items.corrective_advice: When completing the left loop, mimic the gentle outward curve and wrist rotation used for the right loop.

expert_evidence_ref.cue_excerpt: Symmetrical loop arcs mirrored across horizontal and vertical axes

learner_evidence_ref.cue_excerpt: Left quadrant arc noticeably flatter than right arc

evidence.cue_excerpt: Learner performs post-coaching retry with widened outer loop clearance

criterion_results.observed_finding: Grid maintained clean 3x3 layout with equidistant dot spacing.
Learner successfully widened loop curvature around Dot #4, maintaining continuous 1.2cm clearance without intersection.
criterion_results.deviation_analysis: Corrected the center intersection observed in baseline; loop now smoothly envelopes all outer dots.

evidence_ref.cue_excerpt: Smooth outer arc wrapping Dot 4 with proper clearance

criterion_results.observed_finding: Bilateral symmetry significantly improved: both left and right quadrant loops now match within 8% area variance.
criterion_results.deviation_analysis: Reflective balance across central vertical axis is visually coherent and balanced.

evidence_ref.cue_excerpt: Harmonious symmetrical loops on both quadrants

lineage.adaptation_notes: Learner successfully corrected loop clearance around Dot #4 and achieved bilateral quadrant balance on retry.
